events.summary: The first retained raw Apple DocC state after macOS Tahoe 26 Beta 1 and before Beta 2 contains 113 note items; this page structures 10 representative, high-signal entries across the App Store, Foundation Models, disk images, Metal, networking security, logging privacy, text, StoreKit, TLS, and SwiftUI.

blocks.text: Archived Apple note state
Internet Archive preserved an Apple Developer raw DocC payload after Beta 1 and before Beta 2. It identifies itself as macOS Tahoe 26 Beta Release Notes and contains 113 structured note items.

citations.locator: Human capture 20250609212701; exact raw payload 20250609212708; macOS Tahoe 26 Beta Release Notes

blocks.text: Representative Beta 1 inventory

This page structures 10 representative entries across the App Store, Foundation Models, disk images, Metal, networking security, logging privacy, text, StoreKit, TLS, and SwiftUI. It intentionally preserves a balanced set of new APIs, compatibility changes, fixes, and known issues instead of reproducing Apple's full list.

citations.locator: Human capture 20250609212701; exact raw payload 20250609212708; macOS Tahoe 26 Beta Release Notes

blocks.text: Attribution boundary

This is initial snapshot-state attribution, not a claim that every item debuted at the exact seed publication time. The raw capture precedes Beta 2, so Beta 1 is the only intervening 26.0 milestone; later cumulative material and administrative identity facts are not copied backward.

changes.title: App Store accessibility feature labels
changes.canonicalSummary: App Store product pages gained a section where developers can disclose supported accessibility features.
changes.summary: The first archived beta state introduces accessibility information on product pages so customers can review supported capabilities before downloading.
changes.verificationMethod: Observed in the first CDX-confirmed raw Apple DocC payload after Beta 1 and before Beta 2. This is a representative initial snapshot-state item, not a claim that the inventory is exhaustive or that the item appeared at an exact hour.

changes.title: On-device Foundation Models framework access
changes.canonicalSummary: The Foundation Models framework exposed direct application access to the on-device model used by Apple Intelligence.
changes.summary: The initial beta notes identify direct on-device model access as a new developer capability.
changes.verificationMethod: Observed in the first CDX-confirmed raw Apple DocC payload after Beta 1 and before Beta 2. This is a representative initial snapshot-state item, not a claim that the inventory is exhaustive or that the item appeared at an exact hour.

changes.title: Apple Sparse Image Format support
changes.canonicalSummary: macOS added Apple Sparse Image Format support for space-efficient disk images, including virtual-machine storage.
changes.summary: The archived state introduces ASIF images through Disk Utility and diskutil, with virtual-machine backing storage among the documented uses.
changes.verificationMethod: Observed in the first CDX-confirmed raw Apple DocC payload after Beta 1 and before Beta 2. This is a representative initial snapshot-state item, not a claim that the inventory is exhaustive or that the item appeared at an exact hour.

changes.title: Metal 4 support
changes.canonicalSummary: The macOS 26 SDK added support for the Metal 4 graphics API generation.
changes.summary: Metal 4 appears as a new capability in the first retained macOS 26 beta note state.
changes.verificationMethod: Observed in the first CDX-confirmed raw Apple DocC payload after Beta 1 and before Beta 2. This is a representative initial snapshot-state item, not a claim that the inventory is exhaustive or that the item appeared at an exact hour.

changes.title: Legacy IKEv2 algorithm removal
changes.canonicalSummary: IKEv2 stopped supporting DES, 3DES, SHA-1 variants, and Diffie-Hellman groups below 14.
changes.summary: The beta documentation removes several obsolete cryptographic choices from supported IKEv2 configurations.
changes.verificationMethod: Observed in the first CDX-confirmed raw Apple DocC payload after Beta 1 and before Beta 2. This is a representative initial snapshot-state item, not a claim that the inventory is exhaustive or that the item appeared at an exact hour.

changes.title: NSLog unified-log privacy redaction
changes.canonicalSummary: Dynamic NSLog format arguments are redacted when they enter Unified Logging unless an explicit logging API is used.
changes.summary: The initial state documents private redaction for dynamic NSLog data in Unified Logging while distinguishing console and standard-output behavior.
changes.verificationMethod: Observed in the first CDX-confirmed raw Apple DocC payload after Beta 1 and before Beta 2. This is a representative initial snapshot-state item, not a claim that the inventory is exhaustive or that the item appeared at an exact hour.

changes.title: Inline audio playback in NSTextView
changes.canonicalSummary: NSTextView gained inline playback for supported sound-file text attachments.
changes.summary: The archived note introduces AVPlayer-backed playback for compatible audio attachments in text views.
changes.verificationMethod: Observed in the first CDX-confirmed raw Apple DocC payload after Beta 1 and before Beta 2. This is a representative initial snapshot-state item, not a claim that the inventory is exhaustive or that the item appeared at an exact hour.

changes.title: StoreKit one-time and signed promotional offers
changes.canonicalSummary: StoreKit added a one-time offer payment mode and JWS-backed promotional-offer purchase options.
changes.summary: The first beta state expands offer-code payment modes and adds signed promotional-offer APIs, including SwiftUI integration.
changes.verificationMethod: Observed in the first CDX-confirmed raw Apple DocC payload after Beta 1 and before Beta 2. This is a representative initial snapshot-state item, not a claim that the inventory is exhaustive or that the item appeared at an exact hour.

changes.title: TLS 1.2 default minimum for newly linked apps
changes.canonicalSummary: Applications linked against the new SDK use TLS 1.2 rather than TLS 1.0 as the default minimum in URLSession and Network.
changes.summary: The beta note raises the default transport-security floor for newly linked applications while documenting explicit compatibility APIs.
changes.verificationMethod: Observed in the first CDX-confirmed raw Apple DocC payload after Beta 1 and before Beta 2. This is a representative initial snapshot-state item, not a claim that the inventory is exhaustive or that the item appeared at an exact hour.
